# Vendored frontend dependencies

`xlsx-0.20.3.tgz` is the SheetJS Community Edition package used by the shared
Excel export utility. SheetJS recommends vendoring the package because current
releases are distributed from its own CDN rather than the npm registry.

- Source: `https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/xlsx-0.20.3.tgz`
